title: Abnormal cases on the network side

entities.name: Attach procedure
entities.description: Network-initiated attach procedure for UE registration.

entities.name: ATTACH ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by network to accept UE attach request.

entities.name: ATTACH COMPLETE
entities.description: Message sent by UE to complete attach procedure.

entities.name: ATTACH REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by network to reject UE attach request.

entities.name: ATTACH REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate attach procedure.

entities.name: GUTI
entities.description: Globally Unique Temporary Identity assigned to UE.

entities.name: Timer T3450
entities.description: Timer used for ATTACH ACCEPT retransmission.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: EMM state where UE is not registered with network.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: EMM state where UE is registered with network.

entities.name: Lower layer failure
entities.description: Failure condition in lower protocol layers.

entities.name: Protocol error
entities.description: Condition when ATTACH REQUEST contains protocol errors.

entities.name: GUTI validity handling
entities.description: Network behavior regarding old and new GUTI validity after attach procedure abortion.

entities.name: UE security capabilities
entities.description: UE security capabilities including encryption and integrity algorithms.

relations.description: Lower layer failure causes network to abort attach procedure.
Lower layer failure causes network to enter EMM-DEREGISTERED state.
Lower layer failure triggers GUTI validity handling property.
Protocol error in ATTACH REJECT causes network to send ATTACH REJECT.
Attach procedure starts timer T3450 for ATTACH ACCEPT retransmission.
Attach procedure resets and restarts timer T3450 on retransmission.
Timer T3450 expiry triggers ATTACH ACCEPT retransmission.
Fifth expiry of timer T3450 causes network to enter EMM-DEREGISTERED state.
ATTACH REQUEST received in EMM-REGISTERED state triggers special handling.
Invalid UE security capabilities cause network to send ATTACH REJECT.
